$comment: Weak-copyleft npm packages (MPL, LGPL…) accepted by name, as deny.toml does for Cargo (ADR-0021). Used by scripts/check-licenses.mjs and server/scripts/check-licenses.mjs: any other weak-copyleft package fails the license gate until it is reviewed and listed here. Only unmodified dependencies qualify. `coversPlatformBinaries` also accepts the package's per-platform binaries (its optionalDependencies, with the same license), since npm installs only the current OS's one (scripts/license-policy.mjs).

axe-core.reason: WCAG checker of the accessibility tests (UX-05, ADR-0027): src/test/axe.ts in the component tests and e2e/specs/a11y.e2e.ts, which injects it into the page under test. devDependency only, unmodified, never bundled into the app or the installer.

lightningcss.reason: Optional CSS engine of vite 7, installed in server/ through vitest 4 (test tooling, never shipped). Its platform binaries (lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc, lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu…) are covered.
